messages:
Alex (support): urgent — Acme demo at 15:00 PST showing huge p99s, customers hitting timeouts and 502s. They said p95 ~180ms but p99 ~4s+. They’re on a Dedicated pool (acme-prod-pool)
Maria (sre): :eyes: pulling metrics now. any repro steps from support / demo app?
Alex (support): repro: run 5 concurrent chat sessions with bursty prompt (long context + streaming enabled). Happens within 30s of burst. Ticket D-7892 opened with Acme screenshots.
Dinesh (oncall): seeing pool CPU/GPU attach queue spike and many cold starts in the period. p99 correlates with attach latencies (cold GPU init ~2.6s) + model load ~1s.
Maria (sre): logs snippet from control-plane during spike:
```
2026-02-14T22:15:11Z INFO attach_request pool=acme-prod-pool req_id=abcd1234 state=queued
2026-02-14T22:15:13Z WARN attach worker=worker-7 cold_start=true gpu_init=2600ms model_load=980ms
2026-02-14T22:15:14Z ERROR attach_timeout req_id=abcd1234 reason=quota_alloc_delay
```
Dinesh (oncall): looks like Dedicated pool saturated — attach queue backlog grows and autoscale rules hit max_burst. fairshare for Acme is high during demo window.
Jess (product): customer is mid-sales demo, need fast mitigation without long config changes. They’re sensitive to route change but may accept a short fallback.
Maria (sre): immediate options:
- TEMP: enable hosted fallback for Acme (route 10%->hosted, 90%->dedicated) to shed attach pressure
- TEMP: raise min_capacity for acme-prod-pool by 2 GPUs to reduce cold starts
- TEMP: pre-warm model instances with a short warmup job (script below)
- MEDIUM: tighten fairshare caps for demo window and enforce per-customer concurrency limits
Repro/commands I propose:
```
# bump min_capacity
rcli pools update acme-prod-pool --min-capacity 6 --reason "emergency demo prewarm"
# fire warmup job (runs 10 warm requests per model replica)
rcli jobs create --type warmup --pool acme-prod-pool --model redwood-llama-13b --iterations 10
```
Alex (support): tried hosted fallback in another oob case before, customers noticed slight model latency diff but demo-friendly. I can propose 10% fallback to Acme.
Dinesh (oncall): doing the pool update now. spinning 2 extra GPUs, starting warmup job. Will monitor p99. If attach queue > 20 for 60s we escalate to full routing to hosted.
InfraBot: ACTION: pool acme-prod-pool min_capacity changed to 6 by dinesh_oncall. warmup job job-983 queued.
Maria (sre): also found a config corner: autoscaler cooldown was 120s — with bursty demo traffic that's too long. We should consider reducing cooldown and adding a short-term emergency policy to bypass cooldown for critical customers. Filed infra PR to add per-cust override.
Jess (product): notify Acme that we’re doing a short routing change and warmup. I'll draft message: "We're applying a brief mitigation to ensure demo stability; you may see slightly different response times but no functional change."
Alex (support): message sent, customer acknowledged and asked for ETA ~5-10m.
Dinesh (oncall): update: after bump + warmup p99 dropped from ~4.2s -> ~650ms within 3m. attach queue drained. monitoring looks stable.
Maria (sre): follow-ups:
- Postmortem ticket to include: attach latency histogram, pool saturation threshold, cooldown impact, fairshare knob behavior
- Add a scheduled prewarm hook for known demo windows (product to provide calendar)
- Short term: add emergency autoscale override for sales/demo traffic
Jess (product): will share demo schedule and follow up on prewarm automation.
Alex (support): closing the customer-facing loop. Marking D-7892 as mitigation applied, will keep watch for 24h. :white_check_mark:
Dinesh (oncall): leaving this thread open 1h for monitoring, will escalate to eng-platform if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
Acme Demo Bot: "Thanks team — demo resumed and buyer is happy." :tada:
